what_to_test:
Juggle Dude 1.1.0 (36) — automatic leaderboard replay fix

• Record and stop a juggling session, then open it again from Session history. Replay should no longer show a trophy button that opens “send touches” or a manual submission screen.
• For a signed-in player who joined the leaderboard, check that the longest counted streak updates automatically. The best-streak strip is informational; no video or touch-review submission is required.
• Check Customize, replay playback and saving to Photos still work normally. Counting rules are unchanged from build 35.

This build retains leaderboard, Apple/email sign-in, instant language switching, invite-code redemption and iOS 18 compatibility from build 35. Real offer-code redemption and physical iOS 18 camera/thermal testing remain to be checked. On iOS 18, keep the app open during video preparation/export.
